name: confluence-dc-connector
description: Mirror Confluence Data Center pages into an Obsidian vault as Markdown, edit locally, push back.
author: Elvin Huseynov

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && node esbuild.config.mjs production
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
